_comment: Raw Take — 4x/week raw-opinion Shorts for the Life niche. Format: 'Someone asked me: <question>' → Tarun's honest, unscripted opinion in English (decision 2026-07-12: all-English) → one landing line. IG Reel (@mistakenlyhuman) + YouTube Short (Breath of Life). BATCH-RECORD the week's 4 in one sitting. The idea machine (idea_scorer.weekly_raw_take_batch) pulls 4 questions/week, rotating by ISO week so none repeats for ~7 weeks.

cadence.ramp_note: Start 4x/week. Go daily ONLY if 2-week retention holds (run weekly_winners.py).

format.hook: Open with the question verbatim: 'Someone asked me — <question>' (Hinglish ok). The question is the hook; first 3s decide it.
format.body: Raw, unscripted opinion. Personal example > advice. Analytical-but-warm voice. NO motivational crescendo, NO jargon. Hinglish as it actually comes out.
format.close: One landing line — permission or a reframe, not a slogan. Optionally invite the next question in the comments.
format.subtitles: Burn Hinglish captions (sound-off viewing). Add English subs on the YouTube Short for reach.
format.loop: After 2 weeks, keep the question THEMES that hit (relationships / career / self-doubt / discipline / comparison) and drop the rest.
